description:
Update a product (name, description, price). For a price change that must propagate to synced channels, prefer cascade_price_change. Optionally set tiktok_listing to enrich the TikTok Shop listing (SEO search terms, product highlights, brand, packaging, TikTok-only title/description, and category_id) — applied when the product is synced to a TikTok channel; ignored by other channels. For channel-defined ATTRIBUTES (Material, Style, Washing Instructions...) use set_listing_attributes instead: it validates against the listing category's real schema and tells you which values the channel refused, which this tool cannot.

[#c20857]

brand_id.description: TikTok brand id (from TikTok Get Brands). Omit for no brand.

category_id.description: Pin this product's TikTok category, overriding automatic resolution. Null clears the pin. Worth setting when a listing has been auto-filed somewhere wrong (a tee under Golf Clubs, a hoodie under Pet Supplies) — the category also determines which attributes the listing accepts, so a wrong one silently invalidates them.

description.description: TikTok-ONLY description override. Unset uses the product description. Same channel-isolation rationale as title.

dimensions.description: Package dimensions for shipping, e.g. {length:12, width:9, height:3, unit:"INCH"} (unit INCH/CENTIMETER; keep same system as weight).

key_product_features.description: TikTok product-page highlights. Max 5 / 1500 chars total; excess trimmed.

search_terms.description: TikTok SEO search terms (hidden from buyers, boost search). Max 15 / 250 chars total; excess trimmed.

shipping_template_id.description: TikTok shipping-template id to bind (usually set once at the integration level). Binding it uses that template's rate instead of the shop default.

title.description: TikTok-ONLY title override (max 255 chars). Unset uses the product name. Use this to apply a TikTok-optimized title (e.g. from diagnose_tiktok_listings) WITHOUT rewriting the shared product record, which would also change the Shopify/WooCommerce/Wix listings.

weight.description: Package weight for shipping, e.g. {value:0.9, unit:"POUND"} (unit POUND/KILOGRAM/GRAM/OUNCE; default POUND). Replaces the flat 0.5 lb default.

tiktok_listing.description: Per-product TikTok listing metadata (merge; null a key or the whole object to clear). Applied only when synced to TikTok. Channel-defined ATTRIBUTES are not set here — use set_listing_attributes.

name: update_product
